notes: BRIEF/DOC: the brief states `--main ".container.responsivegrid"` selects 'the outermost content container right after the header' on live. False for this site: the first match is `<div class="root container responsivegrid">` wrapping header XF + content + footer XF. Consequences: content-diff inventories chrome on live only (24 false 🔴 on a page whose content is exact), visual-diff mainHeight = full doc, anchor.mjs prints no sections on live. The unique live content-root selector is `.container.responsivegrid.full-width--root`; I added the live class `full-width--root` to <main> so both sides scope symmetrically and kept both evidence sets (…-iter1.txt = brief scope, …-iter1-scoped.txt = content scope). Recommend the orchestrator adopt the scoped selector for all redballtennis archetypes.

INSTRUMENT chrome-parity.mjs: `--json <file>` does not write a file — the JSON goes to stdout (the tee'd chrome-parity-iter1.txt IS the JSON; `chrome-parity-iter1.json` was never created). Also the ICON pairing flags a signature mismatch purely from the hashed local filename (red-ball-tennis-wbg.png vs red-ball-tennis-wbg-d7e509.png) — a basename-prefix match would avoid the false finding.

INSTRUMENT motion-observe.mjs: `--click` widget sampler records only transform/scrollLeft/dots; an aria-expanded/display toggle (the USTA SITES dropdown) yields four null frames and no classMutation, so a fired dropdown reads as 'nothing fired'. Sampling attribute mutations (aria-expanded) and display/visibility of the controlled element would close the gap. Hover sampler reports `transition: 'all'` without the duration.

INSTRUMENT anchor.mjs: prints no sections on live when the root's children are AEM `div.cmp-container`/`aem-Grid` wrappers (no <section>/landmark) — live-side anchoring was unusable on this site; the lift JSON was the substitute.

SOURCE CSS gap: the 404 h2 ramp (76px/83.6px desktop, 44px/48.4px mobile, Graphik XXCond Bold, #000) is not present in capture/css/ALL-RULES.txt (the redball page clientlib that sets it appears not to have been split in); values lifted from computed styles in lift-404-{1440,360}.json.

Live 404 carries two button instances (desktop: grid default--4 of an 8-col grid + offset 3, .aem-GridColumn--mobile--hide; mobile: .button-core--small-fs 14px, default--hide) — both mirrored with the same per-breakpoint display rules so role/granularity parity holds at both widths. Empty .phe-block spacers and .cmp-text__icon are zero-height on live and were dropped.

The button's 450px width is a grid outcome, not a rule: 50% of the 960px inner grid minus 2×15px gutters; encoded as width:50% + margin auto (justify-content_space-around margin:auto) and .button-core--not-fixed-width width:auto, so it stays fluid.
